top.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang: US media
top.description: Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust its co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang, US media reported Wednesday, as the chip giant’s chief faces new accusations of infidelity, after revelations he had an affair with a woman accused of spying for China. The tech company’s board was preparing to meet as soon as Wednesday to determine Huang’s future, according to the Wall Street Journal, which quoted people familiar with the matter. The New York Times reported Wednesday that Huang was also involved in a second extramarital affair, with a subordinate, saying there was video evidence of the 63-year-old executive being affectionate with Nvidia’s vice president of health care, Kimberly Powell. Powell, 48, has been a public face of Nvidia’s efforts to expand the chip technology into higher education and health care, and was speaking at a San Jose, California conference where they “were seen being affectionate at the hotel” by bystanders, the Times reported. The report of the second affair follows Huang’s acknowledgment of a relationship with Alice Huang, a senior executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. The Wall Street Journal reported that the two were photographed together in Taipei in 2024 and 2025. US intelligence reportedly circulated a memo this past spring alleging Alice Huang was an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. The Nvidia CEO admitted to having had a relationship with Huang — to whom he bears no familial relation — in a note to Nvidia employees Sunday, writing: “I was unfaithful to my wife.” The same day Nvidia’s board of directors said in a statement that they’d launched “an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.” “I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company,” Huang wrote in his statement. He has also been called on by Congress to provide a closed-door briefing on his interactions with Alice Huang, the Times reported. As the artificial intelligence industry surge has spurred Nvidia’s stock prices to new heights, Huang has appeared at US President Donald Trump’s side at White House events, as recently as last month when he accepted a National Medal of Science from the Republican leader. Huang was among the world’s most influential tech leaders — including Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos and Mark Zuckerberg — who vowed to self-regulate AI against possible threats, as Trump rejected calls for government oversight and dismissed warnings the technology could wipe out humanity. Nvidia shareholders filed a class action lawsuit against Huang and the AI chip maker for failing to disclose information about the relationship to investors. Nvidia shares have plummeted in recent days since Huang admitted to the affair. top.description: Sundays with Papa. That’s what changed the course of Lauren Tolliver’s athletic career. The St. Mary Catholic Central student grew up as a volleyball player, but started playing golf with her grandfather, Jerry Marcero, the summer before her freshman year. “I learned from my Papa,” Tolliver said. “We would go out every Sunday (to Sandy Creek Golf Course). He was a really big into it. He used to be the manager out there for a long time.” On those lazy Sunday afternoons, Tolliver got to spend quality time with her grandpa and learn about golf. “He taught me lot about the mental part of it – how to be able to stay positive,” she said. “It was really uplifting.” Tolliver put those lessons to good work during her senior season at SMCC. She showed amazing consistency with every 9-hole round between 42 and 46 and all but two 18-hole rounds between 85 and 88. She was the medalist at the Huron League finals, third in her regional and helped the Kestrels win the Monroe County Championship and the Huron League, tie for first in regionals and place 10th in the state. She has been selected Monroe County Region Girls Golfer of the Year by The Monroe News. “After my freshman year, I just loved golf so much,” she said. “I started play all the time and indoor in the winter. My game improved so much.” Thanks to Papa, her greatest improvement came on the mental side. “You’re going to have bad shots and bad holes,” she said. “What makes golfers great is making great recoveries.” Tolliver showed her ability to do that during a key dual meet against Grosse Ile. “I hit my driver into the water,” she recalled. “When I came out, I hit a tree.” Undaunted by the misfortune, Tolliver pulled out her wedge and chipped in from 120 yards out for a birdie. “I just try to stay calm,” she said. “I don’t even check scores throughout the match. top.title: Longtime Rutgers football player 'elated' Greg Schiano returning in 2027
top.description: PISCATAWAY – In the transfer portal era where player movement is at an all-time high, it’s rare for a player to stick with one program their entire college career. Rutgers football defensive lineman DJ Allen is one of those exceptions. The 6-foot-7, 275-pound Allen joined the program as part of the 2022 recruiting class, meaning he was one of the earliest recruits that coach Greg Schiano brought into the program. For that reason, Schiano means a lot to Allen, who had an offer list that included Michigan, Iowa, Michigan State, Nebraska and others. Allen, an Indiana native, has been with the Scarlet Knights for now five seasons, seeing the program go through plenty of ups and downs, including this season’s 2-7 output through the first nine games – Rutgers plays Nebraska on Nov. 14 at SHI Stadium. But Allen was glad to hear he’ll be able to continue to play for Schiano next season, which became official on Nov. 10 when athletic director Keli Zinn announced Schiano would return in 2027. “We’re super exited,” Allen said following practice on Wednesday, Nov. 11. “I’ve been here for five years, and the reason why I’m here is because of Coach Schiano. Hearing that news I was elated. I’m excited to see what we’re capable of doing.” Allen said he’s confident in the program’s direction under his head coach. “I’m excited because of what he’s built here,” Allen said. “You look at his track record, he’s done great things here. I have full confidence and belief in Coach Schiano, what he’s bringing to us and what we’re going to continue to do.” It’s been a rough season for Rutgers in many ways, and the team now has three games remaining with no chance of securing the six-win mark for traditional bowl eligibility. As disappointing as it’s been, Allen echoed a message Schiano has conveyed several times this season – the team is only focusing on trying to win now, not on what’s already happened. “It’s frustrating, but I think the biggest thing is we’re focused on this week and what we can do now,” Allen said. “We can’t focus on the past. Being prepared for Nebraska is our biggest task right now.” This article originally appeared on Asbury Park Press: Longtime Rutgers football player 'elated' Greg Schiano returning in 2027

top.title: Cortaca Jug rivalry returns to Yankee Stadium. What to know
top.description: For the second time in four years, one of college football's biggest rivalries will be played at one of pro sports' most recognizable venues. Unbeaten SUNY Cortland will face Route 13 rival Ithaca College in the annual Cortaca Jug game at 1 p.m. Saturday, Nov. 14 at Yankee Stadium in the Bronx. Cortland, three years removed from a national championship, brings a 9-0 record into the contest and is ranked ninth in Division III by D3football.com and 10th by the American Football Coaches Association. The Red Dragons finished with a 7-0 record in Empire 8 play with last week's 42-24 victory over SUNY Brockport, securing an automatic berth into the NCAA Division III Tournament while extending their conference winning streak to 40 games. Ithaca is 7-2 and comes off a 14-10 loss to Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in a game that decided the Liberty League title. The Bombers' seven-game winning streak came to a close and they ended up 6-1 in league play. This regular-season finale will be the third meeting between the teams in the New York City area. Ithaca beat Cortland, 32-20, in front of an announced Division III record crowd of 45,161 fans at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey in 2019. In 2022, Ithaca beat Cortland, 34-17, in front of 40,232 fans at Yankee Stadium. "Cortland and Ithaca both help set the standard in Division III athletics, and our Cortaca Jug rivalry demonstrates that shared excellence," Mike Urtz, Cortland's athletic director, said in a press release when it was announced the rivalry would return to Yankee Stadium. "It's been called the 'biggest little game in the nation' for a reason, and it's fitting to be played in one of the most iconic sports venues in the entire world." Ithaca won last year's meeting, 26-21, at home. This will be the 67th Cortaca Jug game and the 84th all-time meeting between the schools. Ithaca leads the series 44-36-3. The Cortaca Jug made its debut in 1959, the first Cortaca Jug game. There are now three Cortaca Jugs after the first two ran out of space to chronicle scores. top.title: Your AI agent is only as good as your endpoint data
top.description: Every so often a flaw comes along that shows how fast the ground can shift under IT and security teams. PHP2Shell, a pair of critical flaws in PHP, was one of them. Details leaked before the planned disclosure, frontier AI helped researchers find the flaws, and PHP shipped fixes the next day. For many teams, though, the patch was the easy part. So what does it take to respond at that speed, and where should teams begin? What does governed autonomous IT look like in practice? Picture a loop. Software finds where a risk lives and ranks what matters most. It proposes a fix, then, inside limits people define, carries it out and checks that it worked. Routine, low-risk actions can run on their own. Higher-impact ones wait for a person to approve. A few are never handed over at all. Each step leaves a record that someone can review and reverse. What challenges do IT and security teams face today? Three problems keep coming up. The first is visibility. PHP2Shell reportedly sat undetected for more than a decade. For these two flaws, the fix was a version upgrade. The hard part was finding every copy of PHP, including copies bundled inside other software or extracted by hand onto Windows machines that never registered as installed applications. Then teams had to work out which copies the internet could reach and check for signs of earlier attack. An inventory built from a periodic snapshot can't answer those questions on the day they matter. The second is tool-hopping. Answering "where does this run, and can the internet reach it?" often means pivoting across an asset inventory, a vulnerability scanner and an external attack surface tool, each with its own view. Every hop adds delay. Every console is another chance to disagree with the last. The third is pace. Several security firms reported exploitation attempts before PHP released its fixes, and Cloudflare reported early attacks hours ahead of the patch. Frontier AI models helped find PHP2Shell, and in April Anthropic said its Claude Mythos Preview model had found thousands of previously unknown flaws across every major operating system and browser. With models like these in the picture, the old rhythm of disclose, patch and verify assumes a gap that keeps shrinking. Put an AI agent on top of stale, fragmented data and these problems don't go away. They scale. Why does real-time endpoint data make autonomy trustworthy? Endpoints are where work happens and where many attacks end up, so they are the ground truth for any decision about the estate. Four qualities make that data a sound foundation for autonomous action: Accuracy: Live data from the endpoints themselves, not a snapshot that was true last week. Speed: A short path from question to action, with no hopping between tools to reconcile answers. Control: Approvals and an audit trail, plus the ability to roll back, so any automated action can be reviewed and reversed. top.title: “I’m sometimes surprised” Zubimendi responds to Atletico Madrid rumours
top.description: “I’m sometimes surprised” Zubimendi responds to Atletico Madrid rumours Martin Zubimendi has been linked with a move away from Arsenal in recent months , despite insisting that he remains committed to the club. The midfielder has found regular game time difficult to secure since arriving at the Emirates, leading to speculation about his future. Arsenal were keen to strengthen their squad across all competitions during the last transfer window and added quality to a midfield that had already helped them win the league. Myles Lewis-Skelly has also emerged as a solid option in that area, giving Mikel Arteta further choices. As a result, Zubimendi has spent much of the current campaign in the unfamiliar position of a substitute. Neither the player nor Arteta is accustomed to that situation, but the manager has continued to make his selection decisions with the team’s needs in mind. Atletico Madrid linked with January move Players of Zubimendi’s quality naturally want to play regularly, and reports suggest that he could leave Arsenal just 18 months after joining the Gunners. Atletico Madrid have reportedly moved close to signing the midfielder in January, raising further questions about his long-term future in north London. The Spaniard spent most of his career in his home country before making the move to Arsenal . A return to Spain could therefore be an option, particularly if he continues to struggle for regular opportunities under Arteta. However, the midfielder has now addressed the speculation and made it clear that he is not close to leaving the Premier League club. He also expressed surprise at some of the reports circulating about his future. (Photo by Mike Hewitt/Getty Images) Zubimendi responds to transfer rumours Speaking to Marca , Zubimendi questioned the accuracy of the stories linking him with a move and called for greater care when reporting on transfer speculation. “To be honest, I’m sometimes surprised by the press too. I understand that the winter transfer window is approaching and rumors can surface, but I think we need to be a bit more careful with what we publish. Ultimately, everyone has a team they play for, and we need to respect that. I’ve also read that I might be close, but not at all.” His comments offer a clear response to the reports suggesting that Atletico Madrid are close to securing his signature. top.title: Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin share a remarkable injury record under Hansi Flick
top.description: Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin share a remarkable injury record under Hansi Flick Barcelona’s injury problems under Hansi Flick have made squad availability an increasingly important part of the German manager’s work. However, a report from SPORT has highlighted two notable exceptions, namely Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin, who are the only two outfield players among 23 footballers to have avoided missing a Barcelona match through injury since the beginning of Flick’s tenure in 2024/25. While several established players, including Lamine Yamal, Raphinha and Pedri, have struggled with recurring physical problems, the two defenders have maintained their availability, providing Flick with unusual continuity in a defence that has frequently required adjustments. Cubarsi and Gerard Martin provide rare injury consistency Notably, Cubarsi has featured in 117 matches since the beginning of the 2024/25 season, missing just 16 fixtures. Importantly, two of those absences were caused by suspension rather than injury. Interestingly, even an ankle problem suffered while representing Spain in March 2025 failed to keep him out of Barcelona’s matches. Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin have never missed a game through injury for Flick. (Photo by Dan Mullan/Getty Images) Gerard Martin, on his part, has also maintained an impressive record, participating in 107 matches during the same period. He has missed 25 fixtures, all through the manager’s selection decisions rather than physical problems. The left-footed defender did suffer a metacarpal fracture, but the injury occurred after the season had concluded and therefore did not affect his availability for Barcelona. Szczesny’s record comes with an important qualification Notably, Wojciech Szczesny can technically be included among Barcelona’s injury-free players since joining the club in October 2024. However, his situation is different because he has made only 43 appearances. Szczesny has also been fit, although he picked up the flu. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) The Polish goalkeeper also missed a Barcelona fixture because of gastroenteritis, meaning his record of avoiding injuries does not represent uninterrupted availability for selection. Nevertheless, Cubarsi and Gerard Martin stand out because their records have been maintained despite considerably greater involvement on the pitch. Christensen shows the other side of Barcelona’s injury problems At the same time, Andreas Christensen sits on the other side of the spectrum. The Danish defender, who recently returned from injury , has accumulated 433 days on the sidelines through injuries, equivalent to more than a year away from competitive football. Understandably, his prolonged absences have deprived Flick of a reliable defensive option and prevented him from establishing consistent involvement in the team, which was one of the reasons why Gerard Martin was moved into the centre-back role from his usual left-back position.

top.title: Carlo Ancelotti hands Brazil captaincy to Barcelona forward Raphinha ahead of Vinicius Jr and Bruno Guimaraes for Japan and Singapore friendlies
top.description: Brazil v Uruguay - FIFA World Cup 2026 Qualifier - Getty Images Sport Brazil head coach Carlo Ancelotti has selected Barcelona forward Raphinha to wear the captain's armband for Saturday's international friendly against Japan in Singapore. The 29-year-old was chosen ahead of Vinicius Jr and Bruno Guimaraes after regular skipper Marquinhos missed out through injury. Catalan star assumes leadership role According to MARCA , Ancelotti has entrusted Raphinha with leading the Selecao out at the Singapore National Stadium after Paris Saint-Germain defender Marquinhos suffered a muscular injury against the Catalan giants in the Champions League. Although not his first time skippering the side, the call-up rewards the attacker's growing influence at club and international level. Recent training sessions indicate he will start Saturday's fixture on November 14. Established hierarchy guides armband decision With his primary leader unavailable, the former Real Madrid boss and his coaching staff weighed up several alternatives, including Gabriel Magalhaes alongside Guimaraes and Vinicius. While rotating the armband across the squad was also considered, the Italian tactician ultimately opted to preserve the pecking order established during the previous international window. The Spanish publication notes that Newcastle United midfielder Guimaraes sits next in line and will assume the duties whenever the Blaugrana winger is off the pitch. Rewarding the forward reflects his status as a senior dressing-room figure under Hansi Flick in Spain, where he has already netted 19 goals across all competitions this term despite fitness setbacks. Club officials monitor international workload Because the wide man picked up a knock during the last international break, chiefs in Catalonia will closely track his minutes over the coming days. Initial plans suggest that while the newly installed skipper will feature from the outset, he is unlikely to complete the full 90 minutes in either match to manage his workload. This November trip marks the third time the South Americans have visited the Asian nation following previous stops in 2014 and 2019 at the 55,000-capacity venue, which opened on June 30, 2014. During their first visit under Dunga on October 14, 2014, shortly after beating Argentina 2-1 in Beijing, Neymar scored all four goals in a 4-0 rout of the Blue Samurai before Roberto Firmino and Casemiro netted in consecutive 1-1 draws against Senegal and Nigeria five years later. Asian tour concludes calendar year Following Saturday's meeting with the Japanese, Brazil wrap up their 2026 schedule at the same arena against hosts Singapore on Tuesday, November 17. Paraguay are also participating in the four-team series, facing the home nation on Friday before taking on the Blue Samurai next Tuesday. Returning to Spain unscathed will be vital for Raphinha as Flick's side resume their domestic and European campaigns later this month.

top.description: Steph Curry left Rockets game with an injury © X/ @warriors The Golden State Warriors suffered a major blow on Wednesday when Steph Curry left the game against the Houston Rockets with an injury. Curry held onto his right hip area and grimaced in pain after making a 3-pointer with 7:22 left in the first quarter. He played through the injury for a couple of offensive possessions before asking to be substituted. During the second quarter, the Warriors broadcast said Curry was dealing with right abdominal soreness. The two-time MVP played six minutes and scored three points on 1-for-3 shooting. The Warriors trailed 19-10 when he left. Here’s the video of Curry’s injury: Golden State had won eight straight games after a 0-3 start, with Curry fueling their surge. He averaged 30.6 points and 4.3 assists on 50.3% shooting from the field, 45.7% from 3 and 98.7% from the free-throw line before Wednesday’s game. Heading into the game, fans were confident that the team would record a ninth straight win, but the injury has raised concerns. “That’s how the streak ends? Come on man…,” one fan said. Warriors bounce back after Steph Curry’s injury behind Yaxel Lendeborg’s solid first half Yaxel Lendeborg is turning out to be exactly the kind of prospect the Warriors wanted in the draft. The 24-year-old rookie has been crucial to their eight-game winning streak. On Wednesday, Lendeborg again showed why the Warriors preferred an older, more experienced rookie amid their lack of star depth with Jimmy Butler recovering from an ACL tear. After Steph Curry’s injury, it seemed the Warriors were headed for a lopsided loss. They trailed 35-20 at the end of the first quarter. However, Lendeborg put the team on his back in the second quarter. He scored 13 of his 18 first-half points in that period, helping the Warriors tie the game at 49-49 before the Rockets closed the half on a 7-2 run to take a 56-51 lead. Lendeborg added eight rebounds and shot 50.0% from the field. If he can maintain his rhythm, the Warriors have a chance to record another impressive win against a playoff contender without Curry. top.title: Rob Gronkowski says the Las Vegas Raiders made one of the best moves in NFL history
top.description: Photo by Michael Owens/Getty Images There is rarely a “win-win” trade in the NFL, but Rob Gronkowski thinks that the Las Vegas Raiders just made one of the best moves in NFL history. The NFL landscape changed recently when Kirk Cousins was traded by the Las Vegas Raiders to the Minnesota Vikings. Cousins returns to familiar surroundings, having played for the Vikings between 2018 to 2023, while the Raiders get good value for a player they signed for cheap. Rob Gronkowski believes that the trade is win-win, but the Raiders have actually made one of the best moves in NFL history. Rob Gronkowski hails the Kirk Cousins trade Cousins joined the Raiders at the start of this season and through nine games, it was clear that this was not a winning team. The Raiders went 4-5 through nine games, and even though Cousins was doing well, he was one of their most tradeable assets. The team did not hesitate for one second, and flipped Cousins for good value to bring the curtains on a short but fruitful spell. Gronkowski said on The Kay Adams show : “No, I didn’t call the Kirk Cousins trade. Actually, it caught me by surprise, but let me tell you, it totally makes sense all across the board. I mean, you’ve got to give it to John Spytek, their general manager. I mean, that was one of the best usages of a quarterback in NFL history. There’s no doubt about that. “He signed Kirk Cousins to a deal, kind of a cheap deal, got the most out of him. I mean, he leads the league in touchdown passes thrown. I mean, he’s having a heck of a year, and then boom, trades him, gets value from him. A third-round pick to the Minnesota Vikings. “Let me tell you, it couldn’t have been a better fit for the Minnesota Vikings either. He’s going back to Minnesota. He knows the playbook. He knows Kevin O’Connell. He knows the offence there. He knows the fan base.” Cousins now joins 6-2 Vikings, who have strengthened their roster to improve their chances of winning, while the Raiders pivot to a reset since Cousins didn’t fit their timeline anyway. It’s a win-win trade for both teams, but considering where the Raiders were from a point of view of contending, getting Cousins off the roster is a great move. top.title: “Mediocrity Is Accepted Now”: Fans React as Oklahoma Board Chair Shuts Down Brent Venables Firing Speculation Amid Disappointing Season
top.description: Brent Venables & Oklahoma Sooners © Instagram/@ou_football The Oklahoma Sooners’ season has been a struggle, and with the program’s playoff hopes effectively over after 10 weeks, many questions have been raised about OU coach Brent Venables’ future with the program. However, the Oklahoma Sooners (5-4, 3-3 SEC) have continued to put their trust in Venables. According to On3 Sports’ Wednesday report, Oklahoma University’s Board of Regents chair Rick Nagel denied any speculation around Venables, as the university recently extended his contract at the start of the 2026 season. “The board doesn’t typically comment much on what’s going on in the athletic department. That’s maybe a smart thing. But I want to say this … our head coach, Brent Venables, is not on the hot seat. There is no hot seat. We just extended his contract,” Nagel said. The news of Venables not being on the hot seat despite his disappointing season did not sit well with fans online. “Mediocrity is accepted now. Program is decaying,” a fan wrote on X. The Oklahoma Sooners’ disappointing season comes against the backdrop of the program reaching the 2025 College Football Playoff in a 10-3 season, falling in the first round to the Alabama Crimson Tide. Brent Venables’ Contract Extension Details Coming off a fairly successful 2025 season, the Oklahoma Sooners gave Brent Venables a six-year contract extension before the start of this season. The six-year contract extension worth $63 million puts Venables in charge of the Sooners through the 2032 season, raking in an average salary of $10.5 million per season. If OU were to part ways with Venables, they would be liable to pay him a pricey buyout worth over $50 million. Part of the reason why the college football world is upset with the Sooners’ underwhelming display under Brent Venables could be attributed to the fact that the program was touted as a playoff contender with a preseason AP Top 25 Poll ranking of No. 10. top.description: Liverpool legend claims club should have been stronger over stars international duty concern Dominik Szoboszlai Injury Update Leaves Liverpool Facing Delicate Hungary Decision Liverpool are weighing a familiar international break concern after Dominik Szoboszlai travelled to join Hungary despite picking up an ankle injury in the 3-1 win at Crystal Palace. The midfielder remains under assessment, with a late decision expected on whether he can feature against Georgia or Northern Ireland. That has prompted scrutiny around Liverpool’s handling of the situation, particularly given the packed schedule waiting on the other side of the break. With Andoni Iraola already managing a demanding start to the season, any unnecessary risk around one of his key midfielders would be difficult to justify. Photo: IMAGO Szoboszlai injury puts Liverpool in awkward position Szoboszlai suffered the problem at Selhurst Park and there was no immediate certainty after the match over whether he would report for international duty. Hungary have since opted to delay a final verdict on his involvement until the latest possible stage, a sign that his condition is not yet clear-cut. For Liverpool, that creates an awkward middle ground. If a player is fully fit, the path is straightforward. If he is ruled out, the club can act accordingly. The complication comes when a footballer wants to join his national side and believes he may yet recover in time, while the club would naturally prefer caution. In practical terms, Liverpool could have taken a firmer stance had they wished to prevent participation. Instead, the decision appears to have been shaped by respect for the player and an acceptance that he wanted to be with his country while monitoring the injury more closely. Liverpool injury concern grows before busy fixture run The broader concern is obvious. Liverpool are approaching a heavy spell of matches, and Iraola will want as many senior players available as possible. Szoboszlai has become an important figure in midfield through his running power, intensity and ability to drive games forward, so even a minor setback would be felt. That is why some around the club’s wider support base have questioned whether Liverpool should have been more assertive from the outset. Other leading clubs are often quick to remove uncertainty around players carrying small issues during international windows, particularly when there is any chance of aggravating the problem. From Liverpool’s side, there is also a relationship to manage. Players place enormous value on representing their countries and clubs can be reluctant to create friction unless the medical evidence is decisive. nigeria.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang: US media
nigeria.description: Nvidia’s board is preparing to oust its co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang, US media reported Wednesday, as the chip giant’s chief faces new accusations of infidelity, after revelations he had an affair with a woman accused of spying for China. The tech company’s board was preparing to meet as soon as Wednesday to determine Huang’s future, according to the Wall Street Journal, which quoted people familiar with the matter. The New York Times reported Wednesday that Huang was also involved in a second extramarital affair, with a subordinate, saying there was video evidence of the 63-year-old executive being affectionate with Nvidia’s vice president of health care, Kimberly Powell. Powell, 48, has been a public face of Nvidia’s efforts to expand the chip technology into higher education and health care, and was speaking at a San Jose, California conference where they “were seen being affectionate at the hotel” by bystanders, the Times reported. The report of the second affair follows Huang’s acknowledgment of a relationship with Alice Huang, a senior executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. The Wall Street Journal reported that the two were photographed together in Taipei in 2024 and 2025. US intelligence reportedly circulated a memo this past spring alleging Alice Huang was an asset of China’s Ministry of State Security. The Nvidia CEO admitted to having had a relationship with Huang — to whom he bears no familial relation — in a note to Nvidia employees Sunday, writing: “I was unfaithful to my wife.” The same day Nvidia’s board of directors said in a statement that they’d launched “an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort.” “I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. I love our country and our company,” Huang wrote in his statement. He has also been called on by Congress to provide a closed-door briefing on his interactions with Alice Huang, the Times reported. As the artificial intelligence industry surge has spurred Nvidia’s stock prices to new heights, Huang has appeared at US President Donald Trump’s side at White House events, as recently as last month when he accepted a National Medal of Science from the Republican leader. Huang was among the world’s most influential tech leaders — including Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos and Mark Zuckerberg — who vowed to self-regulate AI against possible threats, as Trump rejected calls for government oversight and dismissed warnings the technology could wipe out humanity. Nvidia shareholders filed a class action lawsuit against Huang and the AI chip maker for failing to disclose information about the relationship to investors. Nvidia shares have plummeted in recent days since Huang admitted to the affair. With Trump politically hamstrung as he enters the remaining two-year ‘lame duck’ period of his White House tenure, world leaders may be quietly wondering how to leverage the new balance of power in Washington. The 80-year-old Republican heads to the ASEAN summit in the Philippines and APEC summit in China from a radically transformed and hostile political landscape at home after the Democrats seized both the House of Representatives and Senate. Constitutionally banned from seeking a third term in the 2028 presidential race, the unpredictable billionaire could be all the more inclined to focus his energy on the international stage. “After bad midterms, this is how presidents reset,” Edgard Kagan, an expert at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) told a news briefing. – Iran, trade, China – That is especially true for Trump on his Asian tour, where he is unlikely to be pressed publicly on domestic politics. Leaders in the world’s largest continent are also hoping to see Democrats push back on Trump’s barrage of tariffs on trading partners, which have stung Asian economies heavily reliant on exports. nigeria.title: Two Dead, Several Injured As New York Building Collapses
nigeria.description: Two people were killed Wednesday and at least 17 others injured, including children, after a three-story building collapsed near a construction site in New York, city authorities said. Images from the scene showed firefighters sifting through a pile of rubble in front of what appeared to be a residential property with its walls torn down, exposing a bedroom and a clothing wardrobe. The building fell into a neighboring excavation site, trapping several people whom firefighters worked to free over several hours using drones, search dogs and chainsaws. “We do not know how many people are still in the collapse zone, and this will be a prolonged operation,” FDNY Commissioner Lillian Bonsignore told reporters at the scene in Flatbush, Brooklyn late Wednesday. First responders tend to a collapsed building in Brooklyn in New York on November 11, 2026. She said two people had died, without disclosing their ages, and said 17 others were hurt, including seven children. Four people were critically injured. More than 250 firefighters and paramedics responded to the scene, the FDNY wrote on X, adding that the cause of the collapse was under investigation. New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani praised the emergency services for their work, saying the site involved “precarious wreckage to navigate and dangerous voids beneath the surface.” “I want to ask New Yorkers to please take a moment to pray for those who passed away today and all of those who are mourning their loss,” he added at a news conference. New York Fire Department Chief John Esposito speaks next to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani at a press conference after a building collapsed in Brooklyn in New York on November 11, 2026. One witness, named only as Anthony, told PIX11 News that he heard people screaming and a “bomb”-like noise as the building collapsed. Another witness, Melissa Orna, told The New York Times: “The whole building started shaking, and then it just fell.” The city’s Department of Buildings said its inspectors were on the scene “assisting with recovery operations and conducting structural stability inspections of nearby buildings.” Ahmed Tigani, commissioner of the department, said construction workers were performing excavation at the time of the collapse. nigeria.title: Who could potentially replace Jensen Huang if Nvidia ousts him?
nigeria.description: Chip giant Nvidia’s board was reportedly meeting Wednesday to discuss the future of co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang after he dated an accused Chinese spy, according to US media. The 63-year-old tech titan, who has led the key AI giant since it was founded in 1993, has been beleaguered with reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including with Alice Huang, a data center executive who has been accused by US intelligence of working for China’s Ministry of State Security. With Huang unexpectedly on the backfoot, and no known plan of succession at Nvidia, the field is wide open for a variety of replacements to lead one of the key AI players should the board decide to oust Huang. Here are some of the names being suggested most frequently as Huang’s potential successor. Internal hire With over 40,000 employees, Nvidia could opt to go with an in-house pick to take the helm, including one of Huang’s dozens of direct reports. Tech publications frequently cited Nvidia’s Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as an easy choice, if for no other reason than she is already among top leadership at the chip behemoth. Another longtime Nvidia honcho is Ian Buck, who oversees the company’s data center clients. He was a key mind behind the software that keeps Nvidia-designed chips in demand. Business magazine Inc. also lists Nvidia’s vice president of applied deep learning research, Bryan Catanzaro, as a possible pick. A family affair Huang could also try and position a member of his own family as his replacement, with more than one option for a bloodline succession. His daughter Madison Huang is currently the senior director of product marketing at Nvidia and is among the names most suggested by analysts. As a marketing leader, she had a multi-year stint at luxury conglomerate LVMH. Jensen Huang’s son Spencer Huang could also be a potential successor. He currently works at Nvidia as the director of product management in the company’s robotics division. Huang’s cousin, Lisa Su, could also be a viable candidate for selection – not only is she his first cousin, once removed, but she also has valuable expertise as the longtime CEO of semiconductor giant AMD. Tech CEO swap Su is not the only tech chief being bandied around as a possible replacement for Huang. Rene Haas, CEO of UK chip design firm Arm, is another candidate being suggested by the tech press. Speculation runs wide in Silicon Valley, where former Apple CEO Tim Cook – who stepped down from leading the tech giant in August after 15 years at the helm – is another person insiders say could potentially be tapped. nigeria.description: By Adesina Wahab Parents under the aegis of National Parent Teacher Association of Nigeria, NAPTAN, and the National Association of Nigerian Students, NANS, have offered tips on how to stop the practice of students benefitting from the Student Loan Scheme and still going ahead to collect tuition fees from their parents and guardians. The practice, labelled double dipping by the Nigerian Education Loan Fund, NELFUND, which gives out the loans, is gradually becoming rampant and erasing the main reason the loan scheme was initiated – take the burden of tuition payment off the necks of parents and guardians. Speaking with Thursday Learning, the Chairman of the Board of Trustees of NAPTAN, Chief Deolu Ogunbanjo, opined that such a practice negates the reason for the setting up of the scheme. “The Student Loan Scheme was set up to give access to higher education to students who would otherwise drop out because of inability to pay fees. It is also to take the burden of fee payment off the necks of parents and guardians. Such happenings may not be totally eradicated. We know how rascally some young ones can be. “I think the way out is to let the parents and guardians be aware when payments are made by NELFUND to beneficiaries. Let there be a means of notifying the parents that their children have benefitted from the scheme,” he said Similarly, the National Public Relations Officer of NANS, Comrade Obidah David, also supported notification being sent to parents of beneficiaries. “If it is a text message, they can send to parents and guardians of beneficiaries. Information on contacts of parents is always provided by students when registering. That is necessary in case of any emergency. Also, names of beneficiaries can be published whether in the traditional media or social media. There is nothing bad in that. It is for transparency, “ he stated. Recall that recently, the Managing Director of NELFUND, Akintunde Sawyerr, said during a press briefing that the fund had identified cases of students allegedly accessing loan support while continuing to place the burden of tuition payments on their parents. Describing the practice as unacceptable, Sawyerr said the fund was determined to end the situation and strengthen transparency in the administration of the scheme. “This comment is based on our recognition that there are so many students out there who are double-dipping. They are taking from NELFUND and still stressing their parents. We are going to put an end to that,” he said. Under the proposed arrangement, parents would be able to confirm whether their children’s school fees had been paid through NELFUND without necessarily having access to the actual amount involved. Early Thursday morning international currency feeds recorded spot quotes hovering near ₦1,345.72 per dollar, while official NFEM benchmarks reflect the closing figures from the prior trading session pending the day’s official fixing. In the parallel market, commonly referred to as the black market, the naira continues to trade at a significant discount to the official rate. Currency dealers across Lagos and Abuja quoted the dollar between ₦1,411 and ₦1,420 for buying, while selling rates ranged from ₦1,419 to ₦1,430 per dollar depending on transaction volume and location. Market analysts attribute the recent softening of the local currency to heightened seasonal foreign exchange demand from importers and travelers heading into the end-of-year period, alongside foreign portfolio investment outflows and a firmer US dollar globally. nigeria.description: By Peter Duru Makurdi —No fewer than four persons have reportedly died, while 14 others are battling for their lives in hospital after allegedly consuming a suspected poisonous herbal mixture purchased in Oju township, headquarters of Oju Local Government Area of Benue State. It was gathered that the incident occurred after three men, identified as Magani, Mohamed and Kala, allegedly sold herbal preparations suspected to contain poisonous substances to residents of the Igede community during the Ihiejwo market day in Oju township, last weekend. According to the eyewitness, “The development gained attention when some of those, who drank the mixture and their loved ones raised the alarm on November 2, 2026, after several residents, who had purchased and consumed the herbal preparations started developing similar symptoms. “While the first victim reportedly died Tuesday morning, the second died in the early hours of Wednesday, and the third and fourth victims died later on November 4, 2026. “As we speak, over 14 other victims are currently battling for their lives, with many of them said to be in critical condition.” He disclosed that the three suspects allegedly involved in the sale of the herbal mixture were apprehended by the leadership of the Igede Youth Council, in collaboration with the Oju Local Government Area Township Youth leadership, and subsequently handed over to the police in Oju. “We have been told that the Oju Divisional Police Headquarters has transferred the case to the Benue State Police Command, where the suspects are currently undergoing investigation,” he said. Speaking while handing over the suspects to the police, President of the Igede Youth Council, John-Frank Ozzidi, called on the Benue State government to ensure a thorough investigation of the incident and guarantee that justice was served. Ozzidi said the Igede youths had deliberately refrained from taking the law into their hands, resisting the temptation to subject the suspects to jungle justice. He explained that their decision to allow the law to take its course demonstrated their confidence in the state government to ensure justice is done in the matter. nigeria.description: By YVONNE-FAITH ELAIGWU The history of payments is, in many ways, the history of making value easier to move. We started at barter and are now at electronic transfers, with stablecoins suggesting that the next evolution is here. New payment methods rarely make their predecessors useless. Cash did not immediately eliminate barter. Cards did not eliminate cheques. Account-to-account payments will not eliminate cards. But payments evolve. And one of the most interesting examples of that evolution can be found in an unlikely comparison: Nigeria and the United States. The United States built perhaps the world’s greatest card ecosystem. Nigeria just seems to have built past it. The American card system is extraordinary. Over decades, the U.S. built an ecosystem connecting consumers, merchants, issuing banks, acquiring banks, and card networks. Around it grew credit bureaus, credit scores, revolving credit, chargebacks, fraud protection, loyalty points, airline miles, and billions of dollars of rewards. Consequently, Americans have a compelling reason to use cards. And use them, they do. Data from the Federal Reserve show that credit-card payments reached 67.1 billion transactions in 2024, while ACH processed an enormous $104.06 trillion in 2024. America, therefore, doesn’t lack account-to-account infrastructure. The difference is where A2A sits in everyday consumer behaviour. Walk into an American store, and the natural question is still: Which card am I using? In Nigeria, increasingly, a different question is asked: “What is your account number?” That difference is more significant than it appears. Nigeria took another road. Nigeria never developed America’s deep credit-card culture. Debit cards became widespread, but cards did not become as deeply embedded in the country’s economic architecture as they did in America. Instead, Nigeria increasingly solved digital payments at the bank-account level. At the centre of this transformation is the Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System and its NIBSS Instant Payment platform, built to operate 24/7 with most transactions settling in under one second. This infrastructure changed behaviour. Any individual or company can pay another individual or merchant, and the transaction can be executed on a Friday evening or a Sunday morning. The expectation is still remarkably simple: the money should arrive now. That expectation is one of Nigeria’s greatest payment achievements. America’s success may be part of its problem. This is where the comparison becomes fascinating. America isn’t stuck on cards because it cannot build something better. It may be stuck on cards partly because cards work so well. Meanwhile, preparations for the aftermath are already under way. A total of 375 judges have been nominated to serve on election petition tribunals, where they will adjudicate disputes brought by candidates and parties dissatisfied with the results. The judges, drawn from courts across the federation, were inaugurated on Monday, November 9, at a ceremony held at the Body of Benchers Complex in Abuja. Section 285(1) and (2) of the 1999 Constitution, as amended, vests in the President of the Court of Appeal the responsibility for constituting election petition tribunals to adjudicate disputes arising from National and State Houses of Assembly and governorship elections. Similarly, section 134(3)(a) and (b) of the Electoral Act, 2026, prescribes the timelines for constituting the tribunals and opening their registries. The swearing-in, organised by the President of the Court of Appeal, Justice Monica Dongban-Mensem, marked the formal assumption of a responsibility with considerable constitutional, professional and public significance. A three-day intensive workshop followed immediately. It was designed to deepen the judges’ knowledge of the Electoral Act 2026, familiarise them with applicable practice directions and the evolving jurisprudence of the courts on election-related cases, and sharpen the practical skills needed for case management, evaluation of evidence, control of proceedings, and the delivery of clear, well-reasoned judgments within the prescribed timelines. The CJN also used the occasion to launch the second edition of the Judicial Electoral Manual (JEM), which she said will help judicial officers locate relevant authorities, appreciate the development of the law and approach recurring issues with greater clarity. According to the CJN, by bringing together the relevant constitutional provisions, the Electoral Act 2026, applicable practice directions and judicial decisions, the Manual provides a useful resource for judicial officers and other stakeholders in the electoral adjudicatory process. She was quick to warn, however, that it should serve only as a guide and a reference tool. It does not replace independent judicial reasoning or relieve any judicial officer of the duty to consider each case on its own facts, the arguments of counsel and the applicable law. A company outside the indexes cannot be added if it fails the ineligibility screen in either of its two most recent annual filing periods, but a current constituent is removed only if it fails in each of them. The screen replaces an approach aimed squarely at crypto. entertainment.title: Olumide Oworu Declares House of Representatives Bid for Surulere Constituency 1 in 2027
entertainment.description: Olumide Oworu has declared his candidacy for the Federal House of Representatives to represent Surulere Constituency 1 in 2027. Photo Credit: Olumide Oworu/Instagram Actor and media personality Olumide Oworu has declared his intention to contest for the Federal House of Representatives seat for Surulere Constituency 1 in the 2027 general elections. He will be running under the platform of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM). Olumide, who grew up in Surulere, Lagos, has a long-standing connection to the constituency. He began his acting career as a child, appearing in television productions such as Everyday People , before gaining wider recognition for his role in The Johnsons and other Nigerian film and television projects. This is his second attempt to enter legislative politics. In 2023, he declared his intention to contest for a seat in the Lagos State House of Assembly under the Labour Party. However, administrative challenges prevented his name from appearing on the final ballot. Olumide Oworu’s official campaign poster for the House of Representatives seat representing Surulere Constituency 1 under the Allied Peoples Movement. Photo Credit: Olumide Oworu/Instagram Reflecting on that experience in his candidacy announcement on Instagram, Olumide said the support he received from young people in Surulere had strengthened his belief in their readiness for more active participation in governance. “Despite the administrative hurdles that left our names off the final ballot, your resilience showed me that our vision was never a passing phase. Instead, it was the beginning of something much more significant,” he wrote. Explaining his decision to contest again, this time for a seat in the House of Representatives, he added: “We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines while our future is decided by a political class that won’t have to live with the consequences of today’s choices.” His campaign has highlighted issues including gaps in public services, community infrastructure and the participation of young Nigerians in policy decisions. Announcing his candidacy, he said he looked forward to continued support as he and his supporters worked towards what he described as a mission to “Reset Nigeria”. Olumide Oworu is contesting for a legislative seat in Surulere Constituency 1 under the APM platform. entertainment.title: What Are The Effective Ways of Using AI?
entertainment.description: Two people engaging with technology in a contemporary hotel lobby work setting. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is changing how people learn, work, communicate and solve problems. In today’s world, if you’re not on board with AI, it could be said you’re being resistant to the fastest-growing technological innovation in the world. From students researching academic subjects to professionals developing business ideas, AI tools have become companions in everyday activities for people. They can help save time, explore new ideas, understand difficult concepts and approach tasks differently. However, as more people embrace these AI tools, it is important to understand that using AI effectively goes beyond knowing what prompts to enter. It requires knowing when to use it, how to question its responses and, most importantly, when to rely on your own knowledge and judgement. AI could make us better at what we do, not make us dependent on it. Here are ways we think you use AI effectively: Use AI as a Research Assistant One of the most effective ways to use AI is for research and information gathering. Whether you are writing an article, preparing a presentation or exploring an unfamiliar subject, AI can help you identify relevant topics, explain complex ideas and suggest areas worth investigating. You can ask it to break down unfamiliar concepts, identify key questions, or suggest research directions. However, do not treat every response as fact. Verify important information using credible sources, published research, books and reliable websites. AI can help you find information, but you are responsible for establishing what is true. Use AI to Brainstorm and Explore Ideas Like knowledge gathering, AI can brainstorm ideas with you. Sometimes, the hardest part of starting a project is knowing where to begin. AI can help you overcome this challenge by suggesting ideas, exploring different approaches and presenting perspectives you may not have considered. For writers, entrepreneurs, researchers and creatives, it can be a useful brainstorming partner. You can share an idea, ask questions about its strengths and weaknesses, and explore ways to develop it. However, brainstorming should not become an excuse to surrender your imagination. Let AI expand your thinking, not replace it. Use AI to Improve Your Work, Not Replace Your Skills This is becoming more important. AI can help you identify grammatical errors, improve sentence construction, organise information, summarise lengthy documents and make your communication clearer. It can reduce the time spent on repetitive tasks and create more room for important responsibilities. The important thing is that you should remain actively involved. sports.title: Longtime Rutgers football player 'elated' Greg Schiano returning in 2027
sports.description: PISCATAWAY – In the transfer portal era where player movement is at an all-time high, it’s rare for a player to stick with one program their entire college career. Rutgers football defensive lineman DJ Allen is one of those exceptions. The 6-foot-7, 275-pound Allen joined the program as part of the 2022 recruiting class, meaning he was one of the earliest recruits that coach Greg Schiano brought into the program. For that reason, Schiano means a lot to Allen, who had an offer list that included Michigan, Iowa, Michigan State, Nebraska and others. Allen, an Indiana native, has been with the Scarlet Knights for now five seasons, seeing the program go through plenty of ups and downs, including this season’s 2-7 output through the first nine games – Rutgers plays Nebraska on Nov. 14 at SHI Stadium. But Allen was glad to hear he’ll be able to continue to play for Schiano next season, which became official on Nov. 10 when athletic director Keli Zinn announced Schiano would return in 2027. “We’re super exited,” Allen said following practice on Wednesday, Nov. 11. “I’ve been here for five years, and the reason why I’m here is because of Coach Schiano. Hearing that news I was elated. I’m excited to see what we’re capable of doing.” Allen said he’s confident in the program’s direction under his head coach. “I’m excited because of what he’s built here,” Allen said. “You look at his track record, he’s done great things here. I have full confidence and belief in Coach Schiano, what he’s bringing to us and what we’re going to continue to do.” It’s been a rough season for Rutgers in many ways, and the team now has three games remaining with no chance of securing the six-win mark for traditional bowl eligibility. As disappointing as it’s been, Allen echoed a message Schiano has conveyed several times this season – the team is only focusing on trying to win now, not on what’s already happened. “It’s frustrating, but I think the biggest thing is we’re focused on this week and what we can do now,” Allen said. “We can’t focus on the past. sports.title: Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin share a remarkable injury record under Hansi Flick
sports.description: Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin share a remarkable injury record under Hansi Flick Barcelona’s injury problems under Hansi Flick have made squad availability an increasingly important part of the German manager’s work. However, a report from SPORT has highlighted two notable exceptions, namely Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin, who are the only two outfield players among 23 footballers to have avoided missing a Barcelona match through injury since the beginning of Flick’s tenure in 2024/25. While several established players, including Lamine Yamal, Raphinha and Pedri, have struggled with recurring physical problems, the two defenders have maintained their availability, providing Flick with unusual continuity in a defence that has frequently required adjustments. Cubarsi and Gerard Martin provide rare injury consistency Notably, Cubarsi has featured in 117 matches since the beginning of the 2024/25 season, missing just 16 fixtures. Importantly, two of those absences were caused by suspension rather than injury. Interestingly, even an ankle problem suffered while representing Spain in March 2025 failed to keep him out of Barcelona’s matches. Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin have never missed a game through injury for Flick. (Photo by Dan Mullan/Getty Images) Gerard Martin, on his part, has also maintained an impressive record, participating in 107 matches during the same period. He has missed 25 fixtures, all through the manager’s selection decisions rather than physical problems. The left-footed defender did suffer a metacarpal fracture, but the injury occurred after the season had concluded and therefore did not affect his availability for Barcelona. Szczesny’s record comes with an important qualification Notably, Wojciech Szczesny can technically be included among Barcelona’s injury-free players since joining the club in October 2024. However, his situation is different because he has made only 43 appearances. Szczesny has also been fit, although he picked up the flu. (Photo by Alex Caparros/Getty Images) The Polish goalkeeper also missed a Barcelona fixture because of gastroenteritis, meaning his record of avoiding injuries does not represent uninterrupted availability for selection. Nevertheless, Cubarsi and Gerard Martin stand out because their records have been maintained despite considerably greater involvement on the pitch. Christensen shows the other side of Barcelona’s injury problems At the same time, Andreas Christensen sits on the other side of the spectrum. The Danish defender, who recently returned from injury , has accumulated 433 days on the sidelines through injuries, equivalent to more than a year away from competitive football. Understandably, his prolonged absences have deprived Flick of a reliable defensive option and prevented him from establishing consistent involvement in the team, which was one of the reasons why Gerard Martin was moved into the centre-back role from his usual left-back position.

sports.description: Brazil v Uruguay - FIFA World Cup 2026 Qualifier - Getty Images Sport Brazil head coach Carlo Ancelotti has selected Barcelona forward Raphinha to wear the captain's armband for Saturday's international friendly against Japan in Singapore. Catalan star assumes leadership role According to MARCA , Ancelotti has entrusted Raphinha with leading the Selecao out at the Singapore National Stadium after Paris Saint-Germain defender Marquinhos suffered a muscular injury against the Catalan giants in the Champions League. Although not his first time skippering the side, the call-up rewards the attacker's growing influence at club and international level. Recent training sessions indicate he will start Saturday's fixture on November 14. Established hierarchy guides armband decision With his primary leader unavailable, the former Real Madrid boss and his coaching staff weighed up several alternatives, including Gabriel Magalhaes alongside Guimaraes and Vinicius. While rotating the armband across the squad was also considered, the Italian tactician ultimately opted to preserve the pecking order established during the previous international window. The Spanish publication notes that Newcastle United midfielder Guimaraes sits next in line and will assume the duties whenever the Blaugrana winger is off the pitch. Rewarding the forward reflects his status as a senior dressing-room figure under Hansi Flick in Spain, where he has already netted 19 goals across all competitions this term despite fitness setbacks. Club officials monitor international workload Because the wide man picked up a knock during the last international break, chiefs in Catalonia will closely track his minutes over the coming days. Initial plans suggest that while the newly installed skipper will feature from the outset, he is unlikely to complete the full 90 minutes in either match to manage his workload. This November trip marks the third time the South Americans have visited the Asian nation following previous stops in 2014 and 2019 at the 55,000-capacity venue, which opened on June 30, 2014. During their first visit under Dunga on October 14, 2014, shortly after beating Argentina 2-1 in Beijing, Neymar scored all four goals in a 4-0 rout of the Blue Samurai before Roberto Firmino and Casemiro netted in consecutive 1-1 draws against Senegal and Nigeria five years later. Asian tour concludes calendar year Following Saturday's meeting with the Japanese, Brazil wrap up their 2026 schedule at the same arena against hosts Singapore on Tuesday, November 17. Paraguay are also participating in the four-team series, facing the home nation on Friday before taking on the Blue Samurai next Tuesday. Returning to Spain unscathed will be vital for Raphinha as Flick's side resume their domestic and European campaigns later this month.

sports.title: Rob Gronkowski says the Las Vegas Raiders made one of the best moves in NFL history
sports.description: Photo by Michael Owens/Getty Images There is rarely a “win-win” trade in the NFL, but Rob Gronkowski thinks that the Las Vegas Raiders just made one of the best moves in NFL history. The NFL landscape changed recently when Kirk Cousins was traded by the Las Vegas Raiders to the Minnesota Vikings. Cousins returns to familiar surroundings, having played for the Vikings between 2018 to 2023, while the Raiders get good value for a player they signed for cheap. Rob Gronkowski believes that the trade is win-win, but the Raiders have actually made one of the best moves in NFL history. Rob Gronkowski hails the Kirk Cousins trade Cousins joined the Raiders at the start of this season and through nine games, it was clear that this was not a winning team. The Raiders went 4-5 through nine games, and even though Cousins was doing well, he was one of their most tradeable assets. The team did not hesitate for one second, and flipped Cousins for good value to bring the curtains on a short but fruitful spell. Gronkowski said on The Kay Adams show : “No, I didn’t call the Kirk Cousins trade. Actually, it caught me by surprise, but let me tell you, it totally makes sense all across the board. I mean, you’ve got to give it to John Spytek, their general manager. I mean, that was one of the best usages of a quarterback in NFL history. There’s no doubt about that. “He signed Kirk Cousins to a deal, kind of a cheap deal, got the most out of him. I mean, he leads the league in touchdown passes thrown. I mean, he’s having a heck of a year, and then boom, trades him, gets value from him. A third-round pick to the Minnesota Vikings. “Let me tell you, it couldn’t have been a better fit for the Minnesota Vikings either. He’s going back to Minnesota. He knows the playbook. He knows Kevin O’Connell. He knows the offence there. He knows the fan base.” Cousins now joins 6-2 Vikings, who have strengthened their roster to improve their chances of winning, while the Raiders pivot to a reset since Cousins didn’t fit their timeline anyway. It’s a win-win trade for both teams, but considering where the Raiders were from a point of view of contending, getting Cousins off the roster is a great move. That has prompted scrutiny around Liverpool’s handling of the situation, particularly given the packed schedule waiting on the other side of the break. Photo: IMAGO Szoboszlai injury puts Liverpool in awkward position Szoboszlai suffered the problem at Selhurst Park and there was no immediate certainty after the match over whether he would report for international duty. Hungary have since opted to delay a final verdict on his involvement until the latest possible stage, a sign that his condition is not yet clear-cut. For Liverpool, that creates an awkward middle ground. If a player is fully fit, the path is straightforward. If he is ruled out, the club can act accordingly. Kulusevski also explained how his recovery weighed heavily on his mind amid fears that he would never play football again. The 26-year-old missed 526 days of playing time including the entirety of the 2025/26 season after suffering a patella injury during a defeat to Crystal Palace in May 2025. He also missed the start of the current season but has since returned to action in substitute appearances against Coventry, Palace and Leeds United. Speaking of his injury and the extent of his recovery, Kulusevski explored how he thought “it’s over, it’s over” when attempting to get back on the pitch and reignite his career before confessing to his mother that his treatment options may not work out. Now the forward is back and fit enough to feature on a professional level and has been selected for Sweden ’s Nations League games this month. Getting on the pitch against Bosnia and Herzegovina or Poland would see Kulusevski make his first international appearance in two years. The Tottenham man also revealed why his recovery took as long as it did. “The reason it took so long is that there are people who haven’t even recovered from injuries like this,” he told Swedish outlet Fotbollskanalen. It would have been a knee transplant — swapping my knee for someone else’s. “So I said no: ‘This is what we’ll do: if I’m in pain when I play, I’ll just have to play through the pain.’ I trained and tried to live like a normal person. The winger also spoke to former teammates, Zlatan Ibrahimovic and Ivan Perisic, who recommended a doctor in Serbia and Kulusevski praised the work and advise he received. He added: “He [the doctor] was so sure it would work out. sports.description: Thomas Tuchel has been England head coach since January 2025 [Getty Images] England head coach Thomas Tuchel says he has "no intention" of leaving the job before Euro 2028 regardless of any offers from major clubs. Tuchel succeeded Gareth Southgate as England boss in 2025 and signed an extension in February until Euro 2028, which will be co-hosted by England. Manchester United are in advanced talks with USA men's coach Mauricio Pochettino over replacing Michael Carrick as head coach. The Red Devils will need to activate a release clause in Pochettino's contract to hire the Argentine, believed to be in the region of around £7m. But Tuchel says his contract does not include a release clause and he does not intend to leave his role to return to club management. "I signed the contract, I want to stay until the Euros," he said. "I want to do the Euros. We have unfinished business." England lost the past two Euros finals under Southgate before Tuchel led the Three Lions to the semi-finals of his first major tournament, this summer's World Cup. technology.title: Your AI agent is only as good as your endpoint data
technology.description: Every so often a flaw comes along that shows how fast the ground can shift under IT and security teams. PHP2Shell, a pair of critical flaws in PHP, was one of them. Details leaked before the planned disclosure, frontier AI helped researchers find the flaws, and PHP shipped fixes the next day. For many teams, though, the patch was the easy part. So what does it take to respond at that speed, and where should teams begin? What does governed autonomous IT look like in practice? Picture a loop. Software finds where a risk lives and ranks what matters most. It proposes a fix, then, inside limits people define, carries it out and checks that it worked. Routine, low-risk actions can run on their own. Higher-impact ones wait for a person to approve. A few are never handed over at all. Each step leaves a record that someone can review and reverse. What challenges do IT and security teams face today? Three problems keep coming up. The first is visibility. PHP2Shell reportedly sat undetected for more than a decade. For these two flaws, the fix was a version upgrade. The hard part was finding every copy of PHP, including copies bundled inside other software or extracted by hand onto Windows machines that never registered as installed applications. Then teams had to work out which copies the internet could reach and check for signs of earlier attack. An inventory built from a periodic snapshot can't answer those questions on the day they matter. The second is tool-hopping. Answering "where does this run, and can the internet reach it?" often means pivoting across an asset inventory, a vulnerability scanner and an external attack surface tool, each with its own view. Every hop adds delay. Every console is another chance to disagree with the last. The third is pace. Several security firms reported exploitation attempts before PHP released its fixes, and Cloudflare reported early attacks hours ahead of the patch. Frontier AI models helped find PHP2Shell, and in April Anthropic said its Claude Mythos Preview model had found thousands of previously unknown flaws across every major operating system and browser. With models like these in the picture, the old rhythm of disclose, patch and verify assumes a gap that keeps shrinking. Put an AI agent on top of stale, fragmented data and these problems don't go away. They scale. Why does real-time endpoint data make autonomy trustworthy? Endpoints are where work happens and where many attacks end up, so they are the ground truth for any decision about the estate. Four qualities make that data a sound foundation for autonomous action: Accuracy: Live data from the endpoints themselves, not a snapshot that was true last week. Speed: A short path from question to action, with no hopping between tools to reconcile answers. Control: Approvals and an audit trail, plus the ability to roll back, so any automated action can be reviewed and reversed.
